authors.bio: Bob Paulson has been involved in the use, development and marketing of professional audio and video recording systems since 1950 service with Fred Waring's Pennsylvanians. At Ampex, beginning in 1953, he participated in the planning and introduction of studio and portable professional stereo and multichannel audio mastering recorders and hi-fi consumer portables and consoles. Paulson's 11-year-old AVP COMMUNICATION consulting practice and membership on SMPTE technical committees keep him in touch with the latest developments and future promises in communications systems. His educational credentials include a Dartmouth College AB in Communications Arts, Thayer School of Engineering MS in Communications Engineering, UC Berkeley graduate studies in Managerial Economics and Psychology of Communication, Simmons College graduate Communications Management program visiting lecturer on the New Media.
